style: Detailed 16-bit pixel art background for a 2D side-view fighting game, crisp pixel edges, limited palette, soft lighting, no characters, no people, no text, no logos, no UI.

office.name: Open-plan office at dusk
office.setting: A modern open-plan tech office on a high floor at dusk.

walkers.note: Coworkers walking past in the background (spec 009 R3, spec 013 R2, spec 017 R3): nine coworkers across the 37-person roster at 60% of a standing person's 150 px; active fighters in the ring are filtered dynamically at draw time.

far.prompt: The view through a wall of tall floor-to-ceiling office windows with thin dark vertical frames: a city skyline at dusk, a purple and orange gradient sky with a few clouds, distant towers with some lit windows, a river reflecting the sunset far below. The lowest fifth of the image is the dark interior wall below the windows. Wide panoramic composition, even detail across the whole width.

mid.prompt: Office furniture standing on one shared floor line along the bottom edge of the image, spread evenly across the whole width: rows of white desks with dual monitors showing code and dashboards, office chairs, tall potted plants, a whiteboard on wheels covered in architecture box-and-arrow diagrams, a standing coffee station with a coffee machine, a bookshelf, hanging pendant lamps from the top edge. Everything is cut out on a transparent background: no walls, no windows, no floor surface, no sky. Lit warmly from the side, slightly darker and lower contrast than a foreground character would be.
